name: omp-plugins
description: Monorepo for standalone oh-my-pi plugins installable from GitHub or publishable as separate packages.

scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run check && bun run pack:check
scripts.publish:headroom: bun run verify && bun publish --cwd packages/headroom --access public
scripts.publish:prompt-border-style: bun run verify && bun publish --cwd packages/prompt-border-style --access public
scripts.publish:theme-catppuccin: bun run verify && bun publish --cwd packages/theme-catppuccin --access public
scripts.publish:all: bun run verify && bun publish --cwd packages/headroom --access public && bun publish --cwd packages/prompt-border-style --access public && bun publish --cwd packages/theme-catppuccin --access public
